newsitem.title: CHILE: Chilean Sept retail sales rise 1.9 pct on 1995.
newsitem.headline: Chilean Sept retail sales rise 1.9 pct on 1995.

text.p: Chilean retail sales grew a slight 1.9 percent in September compared with the same month last year, said the National Chamber of Commerce.
"The low growth in September confirms that the process of adjustment is having a substantial effect on trade," said president Alfonso Mujica.
The figures bring the average increase in sales over the first nine months of the year to six percent.
Sales growth has been slowing progressively over recent months as the central bank's restrictive monetary policy started to put brakes on Chile's robust economic growth.
